title: Rule-level `cooldown`
preamble:
# Rule-level `cooldown`

One rule-header modifier,
`cooldown T`, that gives rules first-class rate
control, and the `where`-condition form an on-delay
takes instead ([LCDB.3.2.3]). The author-facing grammar
is [LGRA.6.6]; this doc specifies the semantics.

Paired with:

- [LGRA.6.6] — the author-facing grammar.
- [LCRS.8.1] — `cooldown` on `call`; rule-level
  `cooldown` uses the same word and concept.
- `LOGICAL_FACTS` — the truth-maintenance construct a
  logical-fact sentinel uses.
